identity.title: The Association of Molecular Gas and Natal Super Star Clusters in Henize 2-10

paper_type_evidence.quote: We present ALMA observations of the dwarf starburst galaxy He 2-10 in combination with previous SMA CO observations to probe the molecular environments of natal super star clusters.

evidence.quote: He 2-10 is the nearest ($D\sim 9$ Mpc) galaxy known to host *multiple* nascent super star clusters
